text: {"claims": [{"id": "c2", "evidence": [{"sid": "P0.S1", "rel": "entails", "sub": "hourly snapshots for the latest 48 hours"}], "check": {"kind": "arith", "expr": "48 / 1", "op": "==", "value": "48"}, "reasoning": "P0.S1 says hourly snapshots for the latest 48 hours; hourly for 48 hours gives 48 files."}, {"id": "c3", "evidence": [{"sid": "P0.S1", "rel": "entails", "sub": "daily snapshots for one or two months"}], "check": {"kind": "arith", "expr": "2 * 30", "op": "==", "value": "60"}, "reasoning": "P0.S1 allows daily snapshots for up to two months; daily for two months is about 60 files."}, {"id": "c7", "evidence": [{"sid": "P2.S1", "rel": "refutes", "sub": "after at least five minutes and 100 writes"}, {"sid": "P2.S2", "rel": "refutes", "sub": "every five minutes or more"}], "check": {"kind": "arith", "expr": "300 / 60", "op": "==", "value": "5"}, "reasoning": "P2.S1 makes a save conditional on both time and 100 writes; P2.S2 says snapshots are every five minutes or more, so a crash can lose more than five minutes."}, {"id": "c11", "evidence": [], "check": null, "reasoning": "P6.S1 only recommends verifying file size and possibly SHA1; it does not say file size alone guarantees an intact backup."}]}
